function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy was a prominent Indian politician best known for his long association with the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and his service as a Union Minister of State for Finance during the late 1990s and early 2000s. Born in 1945, he entered politics in the 1970s and rose through the ranks of the TDP, eventually becoming one of its senior leaders. In 1998, he was appointed Minister of State for Finance in Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s cabinet, where he played a key role in shaping fiscal policy and budgetary matters. Reddy was also elected to the Lok Sabha multiple times, representing constituencies in Andhra Pradesh/Telangana. He passed away on 27 January 2019 at the age of 73.
